name: accessibility-preferences
title: Accessibility preferences
description: The settings people reach for first: text size with a live sample, motion, contrast, underlined links and keyboard hints, each applied at once.
docs: textSize is an index into TEXT_SIZE_STEPS (from steps.ts): apply its scale to your root font size. motion and contrast are plain values for a data attribute or a CSS variable; applying them is yours. Leave systemMotion out and Follow system reads prefers-reduced-motion from the browser.
